camps.name: Arrowhead Day Camp
camps.description_short: Traditional day camp in West Chester, running since 1956, for boys and girls ages 4 to 13. Tuition covers door to door busing, lunch and snacks, daily swim lessons in four heated pools and dozens of activities from archery and boating on the camp lake to gymnastics, zip line and tennis.
camps.refund_policy_summary: A $500 deposit holds a spot; all but $100 of it is refundable until March 15, 2027. Full tuition is due April 30, 2027.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Each camper takes a swim test on day one and gets lessons in groups of 6 to 12 by ability across four heated pools, plus daily free swim; colored bands mark depth limits. The camp also has a man made fresh water lake for boating and fishing.
camps.notes: 2027 tuition: 8 weeks $6,545; 7 weeks $6,125; any 6 weeks $5,600; any 5 weeks $4,975; any 4 weeks $4,545; first or last 4 consecutive weeks $4,245. Horseback riding twice a week is extra ($350 to $450). These rates apply to deposits received before December 1, 2026; later deposits pay a higher Tier 2 rate that the page does not list. Tuition includes door to door transportation, lunch and snacks; families who drive (9:30 drop off, 3:00 pick up) get $100 a week off, and meeting at a bus stop takes $50 a week off. Extended day 7:30 to 5:30 at no extra cost. Sibling and referral discounts. Dates are tentative pending school snow days.

camps.name: Benchmark Camp
camps.description_short: Five week summer program at Benchmark School in Media for rising 1st to 6th graders, built for bright kids with dyslexia, ADHD or other learning differences. Mornings mix small group reading, writing and executive function lessons with recreation; full day campers add afternoons of sports, swimming, art and a ropes course with a zipline.
camps.special_needs_notes: Designed for children with dyslexia, ADHD, auditory processing or other learning differences. Language arts classes have up to nine students with a head teacher and an assistant; new campers get a reading assessment after registering for class placement.
camps.notes: Full day 8:15 to 4:00, half day 8:15 to 12:15, or language arts only (8:15 to 10:00 or 10:30 to 12:15). After camp care 4:00 to 6:00. Full day campers bring lunch unless they buy the hot lunch program. No camp July 5, 2027. The pricing page says to check back in December for 2027 rates.

camps.special_needs_notes: An inclusive program that tries to accommodate campers, but staff are not behavioral intervention professionals and may not manage every medical, behavioral or social need; families are asked to call about support. Campers must be toilet trained and able to communicate their needs.

camps.name: Camp Galil
camps.description_short: Jewish overnight camp of the Habonim Dror youth movement on 63 acres in upper Bucks County, about 30 miles north of Philadelphia. Campers live in cabins by grade and do sports, arts, performing arts, nature and outdoor adventure, a heated pool with swim lessons for younger campers, Israel education and group decision making, with one to seven week sessions.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Deposit $750 ($375 for Taste of Galil), with $50 non-refundable. Withdraw in writing: full refund through February 28, then $200 in March, $500 in April, 20% in May, 50% June 1 to 10, and no refund after June 10.
camps.notes: 2027 regular rates (early bird discounts ended October 15). First time campers get a lower rate: First Session $7,475, Second Session $6,285, Mini-Session Alef $4,500, Full Summer $12,275. Extra fees: $50 Habonim Dror membership, $75 security fee and medication fees. Sibling discount $150 for a second child and $250 for each further child. Need based scholarships and One Happy Camper grants for first time campers. The rates page shows no price for Mini-Session Bet or Taste of Galil Bet, and lists a $5,475 rate for June 25 to August 15 without a program name; left out. Office: 2037 Chestnut Street #2159, Philadelphia.

camps.name: Camp Saginaw
camps.description_short: Family run coed overnight camp for about 400 kids ages 6 to 16 on over 400 wooded acres in southern Chester County, founded in 1927 and marking its 100th summer in 2027. Campers do athletics, arts and ceramics, two pools, a lake and Big Elk Creek, ropes and aerial courses, zip lines, dirt bikes and trips, in full, half and two week sessions.
camps.refund_policy_summary: A $2,500 deposit at enrollment, $500 of it a non-refundable application fee; no refunds for cancellations after January 1, 2027. A first time camper who leaves early gets the unused days refunded.
camps.notes: 2027 tuition has three tiers (early bird, standard, late spring); the page does not give the tier dates, so the standard rate is recorded. Early bird / late spring: Full Season $13,000 / $14,000; First Half $8,600 / $9,050; Second Half grades 1 to 5 $5,700 / $6,250; grades 6 to 11 $6,800 / $7,250; Two Weeks $5,000 / $5,450. Two Weeks and Rookie Day are for first time campers only. Cash or check prices; 3% card fee. Tuition includes trips, canteen, laundry and coach bus transportation. Sibling, alumni and referral discounts. Winter office in Cherry Hill, NJ.

camps.description_short: Weekly nature day camp on the Schuylkill Center's 365 acres in Roxborough for ages 4 to 13, grouped by age. camps.refund_policy_summary: A 50% deposit holds a spot until April 19, 2027, and half of that deposit is refundable until then; after April 19 full payment is due and fees are non-refundable.
camps.notes: 2027 weekly rates: ages 4 to 9 $500 (half day for ages 4 to 5 $375), ages 10 to 11 $550, ages 12 to 13 $610; the shortened July 5 week is $400, $440 or $488. Whole summer: $3,750, $4,125 or $4,575. One rate for everyone; members register first (from November 23, 2026), the public from January 4, 2027. 5% early bird through January 31, 5% sibling discount. Hours 9:00 to 3:30; before care 8:00 to 9:00 ($75 a week), aftercare 3:30 to 6:00 ($125 a week). Campers bring lunch. Accepts Child Care Works subsidy and the Youth Access $600 grant.

camps.name: College Settlement Day Camp
camps.description_short: Two week day camp on a 235 acre property in Horsham for ages 7 to 12, mixing environmental activities like creek crawls, fishing, gardening and hiking with swimming, a bike riding program, a climbing tower and sports, with buses from Philadelphia.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Cancel any time before camp; the $75 deposit is refunded only with at least two weeks' notice. No refund if a camper is dismissed for conduct; prorated refunds for medical departures.
camps.notes: Four two week sessions, Monday to Friday; each camper can attend up to two sessions (four weeks). Breakfast, lunch and a snack are provided each day. Buses run from five Philadelphia stops (McClure, Pennypacker, Solis-Cohen and Finletter schools and the Community Center at Visitation in Kensington); car drop off 7:45 to 8:45 am, pick up 4:15 to 5:30 pm. The $920 full price includes the $75 deposit; families can apply for a need based scholarship discount, plus $25 sibling and $15 referral discounts. Summer 2027 dates and prices are not posted yet. The same nonprofit runs an overnight camp next door.

camps.notes: 2026 rates: non-residents $125 a week ($100 for the 4 day week of June 29); Tredyffrin residents $100 a week ($80 for that week). Tykes camp for the youngest children runs in the Picnic Pavilion. Registration by mailed or dropped off form with cash or check. Camp is cancelled in rain; there is no indoor space. 2027 information not yet posted.

camps.name: Upper Main Line YMCA Camp (Camp UMLY)
camps.description_short: YMCA day camp at the Upper Main Line YMCA's campus in Berwyn, beside Natural Lands' Cassatt Preserve, for ages 5 to 16. Traditional campers swim daily, play sports and gaga, canoe, do crafts and take field trips every other week; specialty weeks cover theater, dance, nature, farm, woodworking, STEM, sports and tennis, plus BumbleBee adaptive camps.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Cancel at least two weeks before the camp week for a refund of fees paid, less the non-refundable $35 a week deposit; no refunds or changes within two weeks of the start, or for illness.
camps.special_needs_notes: BumbleBee adaptive camps (ages 6 to 12 and 12 to 16, full or half day) serve campers with developmental and intellectual disabilities who need more support.

sessions.name: Week 1: Jurassic Jungle (no camp Friday June 19)

camps.notes: 2026 prices shown are the guest (non-member) weekly rates: traditional camp $519 (members $439); specialty camps mostly $519 or $606 (members $439 or $519); half day preschool camps for ages 5 to 6 $290 to $377; Teen Trek $655 ($540); CIT $310 ($261); BumbleBee adaptive $605 ($544); the two week Summer Stage show camp is $917 ($763). Week 1 is four days and prorated. Some camps also run pre-weeks June 1 to 5 and June 8 to 12. Camp 9 to 4; Morning SPARK 7 to 9 is $25 a week; 4 to 6 pm is included. Sibling discount; YMCA financial assistance and Child Care Works funding accepted.

camps.name: West Chester YMCA Camp
camps.description_short: YMCA day camp at the West Chester Area YMCA for ages 5 to 15, grouped by age, with daily swimming, gaga, a hammock village, arts and crafts, sports and nature, and field trips every other week. Also offers aquatics camps for ages 7 to 11, Teen Trek for ages 12 to 15 and a Leaders in Training program.
